title: Cluster registry: NodeRegistry + resolve + tagging

findings.title: Re-registering the same node_id silently overwrites the previous session without closing that connection
Malformed commands/tags/version silently downgrade to empty/None; a node with no declared commands still occupies a fleet slot
Two distinct node_ids registering on the same conn_id leave the first session orphaned
register/deregister/forget are silent; 'node came back online' has no log breadcrumb
resolve_all_by_tags returns HashMap iteration order; fan-out spawn order differs between calls
NodeMatch has no Debug impl; test failures cannot pretty-print it
ResolveError has Display but no test coverage
maybe_register_node falls back to 'unknown' when device_name is absent without logging

clean_areas: Lock-poisoning recovery consistent across the registry
forget drops the write lock before signalling — no deadlock on re-entry
normalize_node_key is Unicode-aware and tested against CJK names
